column1: # The checks of the units too long for a GitHub check job even alone (tools/oft/plan.py, offloaded: measured minutes
# on the 16-core runner over 226.7), each done on the build service (builds-ossv) at one key of one part.  One row per
# unit, part and key: the build-service job, the SHA-256 of its result.json, and the date (YYYY-MM-DD).  `oft plan`
# takes a part's row at the part's current key in place of a check job, and fails, naming the unit, the part and the
# key, when there is none.  keys.NOT_THE_CHECKER names this file, so a new row re-keys nothing.
